newsitem.title: USA: Winstar, GTE in interconnection pact.
newsitem.headline: Winstar, GTE in interconnection pact.

text.p: WinStar Communications Inc and GTE Corp said on Wednesday they had signed an interconnect pact covering the entire Tampa Bay market, where GTE Florida is the incumbent local exchange carrier.
The two companies said they had previously been in arbritation, but had been able to negotiate an agreement which put aside certain open issues for resolution at a later date.
WinStar said it now has interconnect agreements covering 11 of 41 major market areas in which it plans to roll out its local exchange carrier business over the next three years.
